name: Taj Mahal
description: World-renowned white marble mausoleum built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, a UNESCO World Heritage site and masterpiece of Mughal architecture.

name: Agra Fort
description: Massive 16th-century red sandstone fortress that served as the main residence of Mughal emperors, containing the Jahangiri Mahal, Diwan-i-Khas, and Sheesh Mahal.

name: Mehtab Bagh Sunset Viewpoint
description: Charbagh complex situated across the Yamuna River directly aligned with the Taj Mahal, providing unforgettable sunset views without the crowds.

name: Fatehpur Sikri Royal Complex
description: Akbar's 16th-century red sandstone fortified capital city featuring the monumental Buland Darwaza and the Tomb of Salim Chishti.

name: Sadar Bazaar & Petha Tasting Walk
description: Bustling Agra market street famous for authentic handcrafted marble souvenirs and classic Agra Petha varieties (Angoori, Kesar, and Paan petha).
